title: Documentation on charging in IMS
html:
There is a new small article by Carsten Bock on how billing is done in IMS. It is available here:

  • Understanding Charging in the IP-Multimedia-Subsystem (IMS)

We are working on integrating Kamailio with the Mobicents Charging Server; the connection between the two systems will be done using Diameter.
